warnings: Grid bubbles are printed on every structural plan and on the architectural plan/sections: x = 1-5 (4 bays x 5.50 = 22.00), y = A-E (3.00 / 4.00 / 5.00 / 4.00 = 16.00). Origin A1 (top-left as drawn). All five rows and five column lines carry columns (C1 / CX), so all ten are named lines.
The scanned PDF pages carry /Rotate 180 (they display upside down); the drawings themselves are upright in the stored frame and were read upright.

Before-origin dummies share the first main line's prime sequence (section 4): x 1' -2.00, 1'' -1.50, 1''' -1.00, 1'''' -0.40 then 1''''' 2.75, 1'''''' 4.00 in the 1-2 gap; y A' -2.00, A'' -1.75, A''' -1.70, A'''' -1.50 then A''''' 1.50 in the A-B gap.

A'' (-1.75, architectural floor plan A-02, front walkway edge) and A''' (-1.70, structural S-02 canopy slab edge, also printed 1.70 on section A-A) are 0.05 apart and may be the same front edge printed twice by two disciplines; both are kept as lines (section 4 rule 4: do not pick one).

A'''' (-1.50) is the end of the cantilever beams B6A/B7A as printed on their own elevations (S-09, 1.50 beyond row A); the edge beams B4/B4'/B11 and the canopy beams B9/B10 are placed on this line in the beam plan. The plan's 1.70 is the outer slab edge, so the beam line sits about one beam width inside it.

D' (14.00) carries the purlin-support truss T2: S-04 draws T2 between D and E without a printed chain; the T1 detail (S-10) puts the T2 centreline two ~1.00 panels from the E-side support (scaled ~1.96). Position scaled, not printed — the line carries its own lowered score.

Conflict: section B-B (A-07) labels the truss-bearing level '+3.50 ระดับหลังหัวเสารับ TRESS', the same text as the +3.50 soffit level below it, while its own chain puts that tick ~1.00 above +3.50 and section A-A prints '+4.50 ระดับหลังเสารับTRUSS'. Taken: +4.50 (one label + two chains agree; the B-B label is a copy error).

Element-internal dimensions are kept on the elements, not here (section 4 rule 4 exception): the bar curtailment chains printed under every beam elevation on S-08/S-09 (e.g. B1 0.70 | 3.50 | 1.30 ..., B5 0.95 | 3.10 | 0.95, B4' bar end 1.00, B4 cut-off 1.15 | 4.35), the truss panel chains (~1.00 x 19 on T1, ~1.10 x 10 on T2/T3), footing plan sizes (0.70 / 1.50 / 2.00) and section depths.

Dimension sweep covers the structural plans S-01 to S-05, the beam and truss elevations S-08 to S-10, and the architectural sheets A-02 (floor plan), A-03 / A-04 (roof plans), A-05 / A-06 (elevations) and A-07 (building sections). Not swept for ticks: A-08 to A-12 (enlarged shop/toilet details, furniture, electrical, sanitary layouts) and the detail sheets S-06/S-07/S-11 to S-13 (member-internal dimensions, kept on their elements). The elevations print an overall 6.30 from ground to the high-side wall top that matches none of the section labels (+6.10 / +6.35 / +6.50) — recorded as its own dummy level +6.30.
